method: PO monostatic (Knott et al. 1993 Ch. 5), occlusion on, bounces=1
note: rcs_input excludes role propeller only. Components with transparent_to rf (the radome) stay in the PEC mesh, because that is what acdt integration --rcs writes.

limits.fine2: full sphere skipped: probe 267.37 s/az, estimate 642.1 h for 2 pol × 3 frequencies at 0.25°. Recorded the sample azimuths, including 0° and ±pairs.

second_bounce.reason: n_sub=40 at 10 GHz (ray tubes ≤ λ/6, cap 40). A 2-bounce polar would multiply the 1-bounce cost by about n_sub² per lit facet. Skipped.

copolar_note: On the finished polars, max |VV−HH| is about 1e-13 dB. Monostatic co-pol in this PO has ê·k̂_i = 0, so the facet factor reduces to −n̂·k̂ for both VV and HH (po.rcs).
